passages.note: Mandates AI content-provenance disclosure and detection tools for large GenAI providers; not the dimension the rungs order (free development, voluntary guidelines, harm liability, high-stakes safety testing, or deployment approval).

rows.reasoning: SB 942 (2023-2024), authored by Becker and signed into law, requires covered GenAI providers to offer an AI detection tool and content-provenance disclosures. This is a transparency/labeling mandate, not a measure addressing 'legally responsible when their systems cause harm,' 'require safety testing before AI can be used in high-stakes areas like hiring, healthcare, and policing,' or any other rung text, so it is adjacent to the ladder's question rather than on it.
